summary: First-run end-to-end testing of Vastgoed Kiosk app. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (auth admin+kiosk PIN, apartments CRUD, tenants CRUD, assign/remove tenant, payments with KW{year}-{5digits} receipt format, kiosk public endpoints, kiosk payment auth gating, admin stats). Frontend: marketing landing renders with oranje/cream design, PIN keypad 1234 unlocks kiosk, full kiosk flow Welcome -> Select A1 -> Overview (Jan de Vries, SRD 5.000) -> Payment setup -> Confirm -> Receipt page showing KW2026-00007 works end-to-end, admin login with admin@vastgoed.sr/admin123 redirects to /vastgoed/admin and all sidebar tabs (Overzicht, Appartementen, Huurders, Betalingen, Kiosk PIN) switch correctly. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~770-line module mixing auth, CRUD for 3 resources, kiosk and stats; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, apartments.py, tenants.py, payments.py, kiosk.py) and a shared deps.py once it grows further.

CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for cookie-based auth; works for Bearer token flow used by frontend but cookie-based clients from other origins would break. Either lock CORS_ORIGINS to the frontend URL or document that only Bearer is supported cross-origin.
_set_access_cookie uses secure=False which is fine for current dev/preview but should be True in production (behind https).

Receipt counter is per-year via db.counters; not strictly atomic across concurrent payment requests beyond what Mongo find_one_and_update guarantees, which is acceptable, but worth noting unique index on receipt_number is in place (good).
POST /apartments/{id}/assign-tenant takes raw dict instead of a Pydantic model; minor robustness/validation gap.

_calc_balance counts months_due as elapsed-months-since-tenant.created_at + 1 with no move-in date concept; the frontend Overview correctly shows balance, but business semantics (e.g., proration, custom move-in) may need future refinement.
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete TEST_-prefixed apartment/tenant within test_full_flow; a KW2026-00007 kiosk payment was created during UI testing (will increment year-counter). Existing seeded apt A1 + tenant Jan de Vries retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_vastgoed_api.py covers all 12 functional scenarios; rerun with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_vastgoed_api.py -v. Frontend kiosk flow requires localStorage kiosk_token (or PIN entry via /vastgoed/login). Selectors used: button:has-text('1'..'9'), 'Start', 'Appt. A1' text, 'Betaal nu', 'Verder', 'Bevestig betaling'. Admin tabs: text matches 'Overzicht', 'Appartementen', 'Huurders', 'Betalingen', 'Kiosk'. Kiosk PIN may have been left at default 1234 (unchanged by tests).
